title: Work index and case studies
brief: Work index for all 14 projects with accessible filters, and case-study pages for multi-repo (Food Court) and no-UI (writing-harness) projects, in the Dither Layer system

artboards.title: Index: Ledger
artboards.tradeoff: Densest and fastest to scan for tech leads; least visual, the brand lives only in small glyphs

artboards.title: Index: Systems atlas
artboards.tradeoff: Shows each system's repo shape at a glance and groups by surface; longer page, less dense

artboards.title: Case study: Dossier (Food Court)
artboards.tradeoff: Editorial depth with a sticky table of contents and the architecture map as centerpiece; the demo comes later in the page

artboards.title: Case study: Terminal-first (writing-harness)
artboards.tradeoff: Proof first: the demonstration leads, so no-UI projects weigh the same as apps; less room for narrative above the fold
